blockers.detail: FLASH-ENC-01 covers 19 result families in the reviewed FlashAttention export, plus an earlier memory footer that reveals the later 32 GiB result. The comparisons use decoded frames recorded while each spoken clause is in progress and the time when that clause ends. They are scoped beat observations, not proof that a value was absent from every earlier scene. At 337.433 s, the full local-memory inventory is already visible: 16 KiB each for Q, K, and V; 32 KiB for the output accumulator; 64 KiB for the score tile; and a 144 KiB subtotal. The Q/K/V clause ends at 339.159 s, the output/score clause at 348.271 s, and the subtotal clause at 351.996 s. At 413.033 s, the roofline panel already shows 989.5 TFLOP/s, 295.4 FLOPs/byte, and 3.35 TFLOP/s; their clauses end at 415.850 s, 427.363 s, and 434.750 s. The deliberately wrong equal-block mean 28.655 appears at 685.300 s before its clause ends at 688.025 s. The overflow-rejection result appears at 769.867 s before its clause ends at 773.945 s. At 1069.567 s, the memory panel shows the 32 GiB saved probability matrix, an 8 MiB log-sum-exp (LSE) array, a 4,096-fold array-size ratio, and 64 GiB of logical write-plus-read transfers. The ratio compares these arrays, not total training memory. Their explanations end at 1073.847 s, 1079.459 s, and 1093.758 s. At prefill beat entry, 1771.800 s, the panel already shows 33,558,528 valid pairs per head and a 4,096.5-fold pair-count ratio. The pair-count clause ends at 1776.650 s; the ratio clause does not begin until 1794.164 s and ends at 1800.051 s. The panel is drawn unconditionally at beat entry. In the alignment example, the correct causal average 37.5 is visible at 1920.733 s; its clause ends at 1922.921 s. A frame at 1923.467 s shows the wrong-mask result 10 while its explanation continues to 1930.308 s. In the fresh-cache repair, a frame at 2151.167 s shows 2 while its clause continues to 2155.7105 s; a frame at 2156.267 s shows 255.25 while its clause continues to 2161.2355 s. The repaired m=0, l=6, N=42 summary appears at 2168.667 s before its clause ends at 2173.785 s, and output 7 appears at 2174.233 s before its clause ends at 2175.498 s. The previously cited 1930.300 s, 2155.700 s, and 2161.233 s values are last-incomplete-frame samples, not reveal times. Earlier during-clause samples already show those outputs at 1923.467 s, 2151.167 s, and 2156.267 s; the last two cited frames are only about 10.5 ms and 2.2 ms before their clauses end. Some results switch on at cue start, while other panels are present unconditionally at chapter or beat entry. The 160.000 s memory-scene footer already shows the complete 8 × 32 × 8192² × 2 bytes = 32 GiB equation; the later memory-ledger derivation ends at 232.408 s. The fresh question remains neutral and the final arithmetic is correct, so these findings concern reveal timing rather than incorrect calculations. The evidence is tied to the archived reviewed movie (SHA-256 33fbcae4a7ed); the 2026-11-08 candidate is marked audio-ready with direction review unrevisited, so this evidence does not verify the latest candidate or current publication.
